title: Validate an ISBN-10 code
summary: Validate an ISBN-10 identifier, allowing hyphens as separators.
requirements: After removing hyphens, exactly ten characters remain.
Only the last character may be X, representing ten.
The weighted sum (10 to 1) must be divisible by 11.
hints: Strip hyphens and validate the character layout.
Use decreasing weights from the first digit to the last.
